name: Certified in the Governance of Enterprise IT

logistics.format: Multiple-choice, computer-based at PSI testing centers or remotely proctored

recommended_certs.rationale: CISA で監査の語彙を、CGEIT で IT ガバナンスの語彙を持つ二段構えはエンタープライズ案件で定番。
CRISC のリスク管理語彙の拡張として、ガバナンス側の包括資格として CGEIT を取得するパターン。
CISSP 取得者がエグゼクティブ層に向かう際にガバナンス専用資格として追加するキャリアパス。

third_party_evaluations.summary: Positioned as ISACA's executive-level governance credential; framework-agnostic IT governance.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced expert: 2, professional: 1. The ordered median is expert. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Verified five-year experience, executive recognition and framework-independent governance support expert organizational direction, reinforced by Japanese delivery; the credential does not demonstrate hands-on technical security.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Accreditation, verified five-year experience and executive, framework-agnostic governance scope support expert organizational direction. The multiple-choice and nontechnical focus limit operational inference, but executive responsibility is the relevant assessed domain.

alex-novak.rationale: Verified five-year experience and framework-independent governance scope support professional executive advice. The multiple-choice, non-hands-on assessment does not establish the expert technical or applied leadership evidence I would require.
